bullets.text: A two-foot-wide sinkhole on Velachery Main Road caused traffic disruption, and the office should monitor repair works.

Students and parents near Tiruttani are scared of venomous creatures due to overgrown bushes inside the Mambakkam Sathiram panchayat union primary school.
Damaged and missing concrete slabs on the Manavalanagar road over bridge have raised safety concerns among residents.
Residents near Tiruttani expect a new building as the panchayat office currently operates inside a dilapidated rural library building.
Rising demand for artificial intelligence and cloud computing is driving India's data centre capacity towards 2 GW in 2026.
The Greater Chennai Corporation made GPS-tagged photos and videos mandatory for road milling contractors to ensure quality.
GCC Commissioner GC Sameeran launched a mobile kidney screening and dialysis vehicle funded by Mobis India through CSR.
The Global Startup Summit 2026 is scheduled for November 14 at Holiday Inn Chennai OMR IT Expressway to bring founders and investors together.
